=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text minus "-"
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note emiti writes a signed n; the magnitude is taken as a ulong so the minimum long cannot overflow
fn emiti n long to void
if lt n 0
emit minus
emitu add bitcast ulong not n 1
else
emitu ulong n
end
end
fn bsort a edit long 10 to void
for p ulong 9
swapped = false
for i ulong 9
if gt get a i get a add i 1
t = get a i
put a i get a add i 1
put a add i 1 t
swapped = true
end
end
if not swapped
break
end
end
end
fn show a view long 10 to void
for i ulong 10
if gt i 0
emit sp
end
emiti get a i
end
emit nl
end
fn main to int
a = new long 10 0
put a 0 5
put a 1 -3
put a 2 9
put a 3 0
put a 4 12
put a 5 -8
put a 6 7
put a 7 7
put a 8 1
put a 9 100
show a
bsort a
show a
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
5 -3 9 0 12 -8 7 7 1 100
-8 -3 0 1 5 7 7 9 12 100
</pre>
